narrative.body:
# Access fertility and reproductive health

## Place in the process

This topic sits within **Pregnancy, maternity and workplace support** in the **Before birth and starting a family** life-course
domain. What comes before depends on the person's situation and nation; the first
safe step is to select the current official route rather than assume one UK process.

## What this family covers

Find the current fertility or reproductive-health assessment and treatment route without assuming eligibility or clinical outcome.

The ordinary discovery journey is to select the jurisdiction-specific route, follow
the responsible authority or provider's current instructions, and retain the
confirmation, referral, decision or next-step information it produces.

## If the ordinary route does not fit

If a route is unavailable, the circumstances fall outside it, or the source signals
an urgent, safeguarding, clinical or legal boundary, stop and follow that authority's
exception or complaint handoff. The bundle records this branch but does not decide it.

Where a non-public provider is needed, start with the current public regulator, register or commissioning route; this bundle does not recommend providers.

## Official routes

- [England: IVF](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/ivf/)
- [Scotland: Having a baby in Scotland](https://www.mygov.scot/browse/birth-death-family/children-parenting/having-baby)
- [Wales: Children and families in Wales](https://www.gov.wales/children-families)
- [Northern Ireland: Family, home and community in Northern Ireland](https://www.nidirect.gov.uk/information-and-services/family-home-and-community)

These are links and original navigation summaries. A national discovery page is a
handoff to the current service, not evidence that eligibility, evidence, costs,
deadlines or remedies are identical across nations or providers.

## What may follow

The result can feed the next family in **Pregnancy, maternity and workplace support**, another enclosing
process, or a provider-specific review or redress route. Use Graph to inspect the
ordinary and exception episodes, sources, actors, requirements, outputs and outcomes.

## Review status

This record is population-complete for discovery and requires specialist review
before any legal, clinical, safeguarding or high-impact operational claim is
described as release-grade.

narrative.body:
# Learn to drive a car

This normalized family connects provisional entitlement, lawful supervised
practice, theory test, practical test and full-licence output. It has separate
[Great Britain](generated/browser/services/great-britain-learn-to-drive-car.html) and
[Northern Ireland](generated/browser/services/northern-ireland-learn-to-drive-car.html) implementations.
Their providers, residency conditions, learner rules, evidence and licence
handoffs are not treated as interchangeable.

An optional [driving instructor](generated/browser/organisations/driving-instructor.html), a
suitable vehicle and applicable [motor insurance](generated/browser/organisations/motor-insurer.html)
are private dependencies around public licensing and testing. Neither buying a

# Obtain birth certificates

## Place in the process

This topic sits within **Establish a child's legal identity** in the **Birth and the newborn period** life-course
domain. What comes before depends on the person's situation and nation; the first
safe step is to select the current official route rather than assume one UK process.

## What this family covers

Find the responsible registration authority and order an official copy of a birth certificate.

The ordinary discovery journey is to select the jurisdiction-specific route, follow
the responsible authority or provider's current instructions, and retain the
confirmation, referral, decision or next-step information it produces.

## If the ordinary route does not fit

If a route is unavailable, the circumstances fall outside it, or the source signals
an urgent, safeguarding, clinical or legal boundary, stop and follow that authority's
exception or complaint handoff. The bundle records this branch but does not decide it.

## Official routes

- [England: Order a birth, death, marriage or civil partnership certificate](https://www.gov.uk/order-copy-birth-death-marriage-certificate)
- [Scotland: Register a birth in Scotland](https://www.mygov.scot/register-birth)
- [Wales: Order a birth, death, marriage or civil partnership certificate](https://www.gov.uk/order-copy-birth-death-marriage-certificate)

process, or a provider-specific review or redress route. Use Graph to inspect the
ordinary and exception episodes, sources, actors, requirements, outputs and outcomes.
